reasons.product-brief: no product brief with measured what/who/why/how/where/when numbers exists yet; not inventing one
reasons.ice-score: ROADMAP.md confidence 8-9 rows have no linked evidence yet; scores are the maintainers' call, not lowered just to pass
reasons.install-ignore-scripts: bun install in ci.yml without --ignore-scripts; whether the build needs dependency postinstall scripts must be tested by a maintainer
reasons.north-star: north_star.result docs/north-star/result.json is not committed; the measurement has not been run, so there is no real number yet
